cases.title: Clicking an available seat marks it as selected and updates count
cases.description: Verify that clicking on any available seat without the occupied class marks it as selected and updates the selected seat count in the element with data-testid="selected-count".

cases.title: Occupied seats are not selectable and do not affect count or price
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as occupied are not selectable and do not affect the count or total price.

cases.title: Total price is calculated correctly and updates when movie selection changes
cases.description: Verify that the total price shown in the element with data-testid="total-price" is calculated as the number of selected seats multiplied by the selected movie's price from data-testid="movie-select", and that changing the selected movie updates the total price accordingly.

cases.title: Select Movie from Dropdown Menu
cases.description: Verify that users can select a movie from the dropdown menu, with options like 'The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', and 'No Country for Old Men ($9)' identified by specific data-testids, and that the movie price updates accordingly.

cases.title: Toggle Seat Selection Status and Store in LocalStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat (e.g., identified by data-testid="seat-1-1") toggles the seat's selection status, visually marks it as selected, and stores its index in localStorage.

cases.title: Dynamic Update of Seat Count and Total Price
cases.description: Verify that the seat count (data-testid="selected-count") and total price (data-testid="total-price") are dynamically updated based on the number of selected seats and the chosen movie's price.

cases.title: Prevent Selection of Occupied Seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as 'occupied' cannot be selected or included in the calculation.

cases.title: Deselect Previously Selected Seats
cases.description: Verify that users can deselect previously selected seats by clicking on them again, and that the UI, along with localStorage, updates accordingly.

cases.title: Restore selected seats and movie from local storage
cases.description: Verify that when local storage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the corresponding seats are marked with the 'selected' class and the movie dropdown is set to the correct option.

cases.title: Default state when local storage is empty
cases.description: Verify that when local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' and the dropdown defaults to the first movie option 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Set ticket price from movie-select dropdown
cases.description: Verify that when the user selects a movie from the dropdown menu with data-testid 'movie-select', the ticket price is set according to the selected movie's value.

cases.title: Toggle selected class on available seat click
cases.description: Verify that as the user clicks on available seats (those without the 'occupied' class) within the seating area, the system toggles the 'selected' class on the clicked seat.

cases.title: Update selected seat count display
cases.description: Verify that the count of selected seats, displayed with data-testid 'selected-count', updates to reflect the current number of seats with the 'selected' class.

cases.title: Calculate total price based on seat count and ticket price
cases.description: Verify that the total price, displayed with data-testid 'total-price', is calculated as the product of the number of selected seats and the current ticket price.

cases.title: Decrease count and total price on seat deselection
cases.description: Verify that if a user deselects a seat by clicking on it again, the count and total price decrease accordingly.

cases.title: Update total price when changing movie after seat selection
cases.description: Verify that if the user changes the movie selection after selecting seats, the total price updates based on the new ticket price while maintaining the count of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that the system prevents users from selecting seats marked as 'occupied'.

cases.title: Verify seat status legends and interactions
cases.description: Verify that users can distinguish between available, selected, and occupied seats through legends indicating status, that occupied seats are non-interactive and prevent selection, that available seats can be clicked to toggle selection, and that the selected seat count and total price are updated accordingly upon selection changes.

cases.title: Verify seat deselection updates count and total price
cases.description: Verify that deselecting previously selected seats updates the selected seat count and total price accordingly.

analysis.analysis: The analysis covers all requirements from e2edev_bench_03-R-1 through e2edev_bench_03-R-5, breaking them down into testable atomic behaviors, normal paths, and boundaries. Specifically, for e2edev_bench_03-R-5, the missing explicit deselect scenario coverage has been integrated into the atomic behaviors to account for toggling selection off and updating the count and total price accordingly.
